issues.where: crops 7 and 8, the mid-field leaves and crowns along the skyline
issues.what: The same flat triangular leaves and shallow spiked bud silhouettes recur across the rows. Even through the defocus, the field reads as copies of a small set of plant models.
issues.fix: Vary the bud profiles, leaf shapes and curls, plant rotation, and stem lean across the field before applying depth of field.

issues.where: crop 5, lower and left edge of the broad foreground leaf
issues.what: The frost runs as a broad soft white strip with combed, nearly parallel streaks reaching onto the blade. It reads more like a brushed fringe than separate ice crystals attached to the leaf.
issues.fix: Break the strip into irregular clusters of discrete crystals, with bare gaps and varied growth directions around individual serrations.

issues.where: crop 4, broad backlit leaf in the center
issues.what: The blade stays a dense dark green almost to its edge; the pale rim comes from frost, while the thin tissue between veins shows little visible transmission. The veins read mostly as pale surface lines.
issues.fix: Add thickness-dependent transmission between veins and subtle vein relief, keeping the thicker midrib darker.

issues.where: crop 1, front and middle rows of bud bracts
issues.what: Several adjacent bracts repeat the same pointed, hooked profile, and the similarly bright frost tracing each lip makes those copies easy to pick out.
issues.fix: Vary bract width, tip curvature, and overlap within each row, and interrupt the frost on the more sheltered lips.
